sentences.text: Gregory S. Paul estimated this small dinosaur to be one meter long and weigh 2.5 kilograms, a size supported by a femur measuring 141 millimeters in length.

Its skull featured a nasal bone with an undulating or wavy profile, notably large middle maxillary teeth, and a second toe bearing a retractable sickle claw, while the second metatarsal bone was distinctly shorter than the fourth.
The wavy profile of its nasal bone is a unique structural feature not commonly seen in other dinosaurs.
A retractable sickle claw on the second toe suggests specialized adaptations for movement or defense.
The dinosaur Sinusonasus was named and described by Xu Xing and Wang Xiaolin in 2004.
Sinusonasus had a long lower leg, suggesting it was capable of running well.
This animal lived during the Early Cretaceous, approximately 125 million years ago in the Barremian stage, in what is now the Liaoning Province of China.
